description: Courtroom-themed AI app that analyzes conversations/disputes and delivers verdicts with shareable cards

design.vibe: Law & Order meets Nuremberg - dark, weighty, dramatic

features.name: Project scaffolding and base setup
features.description: Initialize React + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS with dark theme defaults
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev starts server on localhost:5173
Base layout with black background renders

features.name: Home screen - ALL RISE
features.description: Landing page with dramatic courtroom vibe, PRESENT YOUR CASE header, buttons for screenshot or text input
acceptance_criteria: ALL RISE animation or dramatic entrance
PRESENT YOUR CASE header in gold
Two buttons: Upload Screenshots / Paste Text

features.name: Evidence submission - Screenshots
features.description: Upload up to 10 screenshots labeled as Exhibits A-J with drag-drop support
acceptance_criteria: Preview grid showing uploads as Exhibit A, B, C...
Images converted to base64 for API

features.name: Evidence submission - Text input
features.description: Text area for pasting conversation with party name fields and context box
acceptance_criteria: Large text area for conversation paste
Fields for Party A name and Party B name

features.name: Processing screen - Deliberation
features.description: Dramatic loading screen while AI analyzes evidence
acceptance_criteria: Animated gavel or scales of justice

features.name: Gemini API integration
features.description: Connect to Gemini API for OCR (screenshots) and verdict generation
acceptance_criteria: API key stored securely in env

features.name: Verdict screen - Full analysis display
features.description: Display winner, credibility scores, toxicity, manipulation tactics, red flags, evidence log, opinion, recommendations
acceptance_criteria: Winner hero card at top with gold styling
Credibility percentage bars for each party

features.name: Share card generation
features.description: Generate shareable verdict cards with theme options
acceptance_criteria: Card shows verdict, winner, key stats
Theme selector: black, purple, gold, red

features.name: Case history with IndexedDB
features.description: Save all cases locally for user to revisit
acceptance_criteria: Click to view full verdict again

features.name: Polish and visual refinement
features.description: Final pass on animations, transitions, typography, and overall feel
acceptance_criteria: No visual bugs or layout issues
